active_claims.title: This is a source-graph pilot revision, not a live misconduct database
active_claims.summary: Rev0003 selects and seeds a DOJ Special Litigation Section source-graph pilot while admitting zero person, incident, lawsuit, or settlement records.

active_claims.title: Future records require source-bound claim states
active_claims.summary: The datacube requires a source carrier and claim state before a fact can be presented as a corpus assertion.

active_claims.title: Future person records require privacy and correction routes
active_claims.summary: Records concerning civilians, officers, witnesses, survivors, families, and minors require privacy classification and a right-of-reply/correction route.

active_claims.title: Name-only identity resolution is prohibited
active_claims.summary: Officer and civilian entity linkage cannot be promoted on name alone; linkage requires weighted identifiers and explicit uncertainty.

active_claims.title: DOJ SLS source rows can be admitted as carrier rows without misconduct extraction
active_claims.summary: The cube may hold official agency/matter source rows as public-record carriers while blocking person-level and incident-level claims until later gates.
active_claims.max_public_wording: source inventory row only; no misconduct claim asserted

active_claims.claim: The cube contains source-scoped DOJ SLS matter objects and document-label census rows.
The cube contains source-scoped official DOJ news-event rows, event crosswalks, high-volatility source packets, and status reconciliation tickets.

The cube contains source-scoped current-status candidates, court/order accession candidates, local/monitor source bridge rows, child-agency status split rows, public card copy candidates, history-retention warnings, and ghost carrier candidates.
The cube contains official DOJ-linked PDF URL accessions and bounded noncurrent document-effect proof atoms for a limited DOJ SLS subset.
The cube contains claimless DOJ SLS source-inventory page shells for all 27 pilot matters and a 148-row document-role matrix for triage.
The cube contains a link-target resolution overlay, official-news resnapshots, capture manifest targets, and a fixity-state machine for selected DOJ SLS source families.

The cube contains payload-intake envelopes, privacy preflight queue rows, capture batches, capture ordering, extractive-action gates, custody sidecar templates, release redaction rules, and capture failure modes for selected DOJ SLS source families.

The cube contains source-page anchor observations, diff sentinels, document-link anchor maps, status-label freshness tiers, source-observation events, provenance activity templates, volatile source-family watches, and public change-note gates for the DOJ SLS pilot.
The cube now contains telos, dream, earned-capability, future-session reentry, design-tension, and open-horizon foundation surfaces.

active_claims.title: Future claim candidates require evidence atoms, source voice, modality, privacy posture, and defeater scan
active_claims.summary: Rev0018 defines the workbench future sessions must use before converting source extractions into claim candidates. It does not instantiate live atoms or claims.

active_claims.claim: The cube contains a source-family atlas, corpus-lane route map, pilot candidate map, interoperability contracts, and root-review office index.
Future operational moves should pass through a review-packet shell before source intake, evidence atom drafting, claim candidate drafting, public display, correction, or rollback.
active_claims.max_public_wording: operations policy only; no live data admitted

non_claims.text: No officer, civilian, incident, lawsuit, or settlement record is asserted by this revision.
The source rows admitted in rev0003 are not misconduct findings against any person.
A DOJ source-page status label is not a final current legal status without current docket/source recheck.
A findings report, complaint, consent decree, settlement agreement, press release, or news item does not collapse into a person-level culpability claim.
The archive is not a Brady/Giglio list, employment blacklist, officer risk score, or police intelligence product.
Public-record legality does not by itself authorize public display.
The DOJ SLS pilot is a source-graph pilot, not a comprehensive national misconduct database.

non_claims: A matter object is not a misconduct finding.
A document-census row is not a document-content summary.
A DOJ source-page status label is not independently verified current court status.
No person, officer, civilian, witness, victim, family-member, incident, lawsuit merits, or settlement amount records are admitted in rev0004.
An official DOJ press release is not a current-status claim unless docket/order accession and gate review occur.
A status reconciliation ticket is a work item, not a public badge.
Closure, dismissal, termination, or retraction language does not erase historical public-record carriers.

non_claims.text: Status candidates are not public current-status claims.
Court/order accession candidate rows do not summarize or assert court-order text.
A PDF URL accession is not a document-content summary.
A document-effect atom is not an unqualified current-status claim.
A motion or response is not a court order, even when linked by DOJ.
A closing letter is an official source signal, not a court order or blanket endorsement.
No person entity may be created from public PDFs in this revision.

non_claims.statement: Status proof bundles collate official signals but admit no current legal-status claim.
Public department page preflight cards are private wireframes, not published pages or claims.
Source-acquisition queue tickets are work instructions, not evidence.

non_claims.text: A page shell is not a public department accusation page.
A document role is not a document finding or content summary.
A missingness banner does not imply absence of misconduct, absence of reform, or absence of liability.

non_claims.statement: Agency identity candidates are not canonical agency records, department pages, misconduct claims, current-status claims, or denominator claims.
non_claims.reason: Rev0010 creates a precanonical spine only; external identifiers and merge/unmerge review are required before promotion.

HTTP metadata observation is not document-content review.
An official news resnapshot is not current legal status.
A capture manifest target is not a captured payload.
A payload envelope is not a payload.
Privacy preflight is not content review.
A capture failure is not evidence of absence.
A source-page anchor is not a preserved source.
A source-page delta sentinel is not a public delta claim.
A provenance activity template is not a live provenance activity.
Volatility watch is reconciliation debt, not current status.
A dream is not a claim, product commitment, or data admission.
A current caution is not the whole telos.
